known_blockers: The daily job is seeded dormant and stays so until the Owner's recorded activation (workflow.job_activated); no daily run has been queued by anyone since Phase A, by the Owner's rule that video generation costs money and happens only when everything is proven

No real day has run with both channels bound: the per-channel publish policy, the serial's routing to OFFICE_SERIAL, publishAt and videos.update were exercised only against faked providers and transports

director_may_approve_episodes defaults to false on every channel, so until the Owner grants it (POST /api/v1/publishing/channels/{id}/publish-policy) a Director's PASS leaves the episode DRAFT for the Owner and the serial produces no storyboard on its own
Today's log is still closed at the end of the run, so a date whose run completes is frozen at the run's hour; a full-day log for every date needs that close moved
Character-drift QC is NOT_IMPLEMENTED: quality control reports the check as not performed
No frontend screen sets the publish policy or the Director's leave, and the scheduler panel does not yet read run_at_local; the API carries both
The seeded Character Bibles carry no voice binding and the assembler synthesises one voice per scene, so every serial scene is the narrator until the Owner binds voices

The live database is still at 0038: migrations 0039 (pricing and reservations) and 0040 (research sources) chain in that order and main.py pins 0040, so scripts/bootstrap.py must be run by the Owner before the server starts on this version

No budget and no price are set on the live studio: budgets are the Owner's alone (PUT /economy/budget) and a price enters the books only through PUT /economy/prices, so until he types them a reservation holds a plan priced from settings and the public ElevenLabs figure, and nothing refuses a day that has no budget

No adapter is constructed with a price_lookup (main.py, integrations/services.py, integrations/router.py, media/factory.py) and seed_documented_prices has no caller, so every agent_run still records cost_vr NULL and narration is unpriced in the books

A FAILED render carries no scenes, because assembler._fail_job writes production_json only for a finished render: record_failed_render_cost is called on every provider refusal and honestly charges nothing until that one-line change lands

No search engine is connected and no route exposes research_health or the weekly retest; the Cercetare -> Surse screen does not show the discovered address, its origin or the failure reason, and the frontend does not label BLOCKED_BUDGET

The script-only heuristic and the OpenSearch discovery are proven on fixture HTML modelled on the hosts that failed, not on live pages (no test may open a socket); the first weekly retest on the live database is the measurement
